About the Artist

My Story

Krishna is a contemporary visual artist whose work serves as a vibrant reclamation of power, intuition, and the divine feminine. Driven by a refusal to be quieted by the exhausting demands of the modern world, she translates collective weariness and raw emotion into bold, visual triumphs.

Guided since childhood by an undeniable inner spark, she has always trusted an intuitive compass that points toward growth, healing, and truth. Her creative practice is a direct response to a society that pressures women to disconnect from their instincts. Through her work, she honors a feminine voice that is unwavering and true, creating a sacred space for viewers to reconnect with their own deep-seated power.

Her aesthetic is defined by a fierce, unapologetic maximalism. Centering on fiery elements, brilliant colors, and rich textures, her pieces capture the warmth, chaos, and transformative energy of the feminine spirit. Every canvas represents the delicate balance of finding inner peace while keeping an unstoppable fire lit.

Deeply rooted in the diverse cultures and rich communities that have shaped her journey, she views her art as a tribute to collective resilience. Today, she works from her studio creating vibrant visual sanctuaries that invite everyone to embrace their own inner spark, honor their power, and join the fire.

Let’s get bold! ✨
